note: Anza-Borrego's main campground, on the open desert fan at the mouth of Borrego Palm Canyon by the visitor center, at the west end of Palm Canyon Drive. The hookup sites are paved pull-throughs in one block; the other loops are dry sites with shorter pads. --Claude
summary: Borrego Palm Canyon (Anza-Borrego): confirmed $35 / $45 full hookup (+$10 extra vehicle), 44 full-hookup 30A sites with 35-ft pads (37 pull-through); electric 30 added; reservable Oct 1-May 31, summer off the reservation system (camping 'available year round' per the park's campground map); dump closed Jun-Sep; PIN move ~675 m to the hookup block.
flags: PIN MOVE ~675 m: stored 33.27000,-116.41520 sits in the western loop system (sites 90-120/group camps). Target 33.2694,-116.4080 is the centre of the pull-through hookup block (sites 1-52), which matches ReserveCalifornia's facility point 33.270304,-116.407994. The sites 53-89 loop is just south at ~33.2676,-116.4080.

SEASON: ReserveCalifornia sells nights only October 1 to May 31; June 1 to September 30 is unbookable on all three facilities. The park's undated campground map says 'CAMPING is available year round, with reservations available from October 1- April 30'. The park page names Tamarisk Grove and Vern Whitaker as closed June 1-September 30 but not this campground. So year_round is kept, with summer as presumably first-come. fcfs is left unset because no current page states summer walk-up; the reviewer may want a phone check before relying on summer stays.
HOOKUPS: electric was missing; all 44 hookup units are 30 A.

SITES: 103 drive-in units on the web (44 hookup + 35 + 24) plus 8 hike-in; camp hosts hold 1, 22, 30 and 39; the numbering runs 1-120, so count 120 kept. The dry loops have short pads (19 of 35 in loop 53-89 are 21 ft). A 23-ft rig needs a hookup site (35 ft) or a 25-ft+ dry pad.

NOTE: dropped '~120 sites', 'full hookups; flush toilets, showers' and 'Reservable online' (the fields show them). The stored 'Some tent loops close seasonally in summer heat' is not borne out: ReserveCalifornia drops all three facilities in summer, and the map says camping is year round.
PHONE 760-767-4205 (Visitor Center) matches; the campground map gives the park office (760) 767-5311 as an alternative. WEBSITE fine.
